description: ActivationSymbol hashes and compares function, arrow and a boxed input [Ty], though input is derived from arrow. Hash and equality use (function, arrow). Prove the derivation holds by construction (ideally input stops being stored, or is constructed only from the arrow) rather than asserting it.
